The machine began to move slowly forward.
There was an ancient temple there, and they asked me to get off
the machine and
enter the temple. I learned later that this temple was one of the
largest buildings in the country. It was no longer used because
someone had committed a terrible murder there some years
before.
There was just enough space in the temple for me to enter.
Once I was inside, the people tied me up again. They used
ninety-one chains and thirty-six padlocks! The chains were long
enough to allow me to stand and walk around. Ill never forget
how surprised and frightened the people were, when they saw
me stand up and walk!
Now the Emperor himself came to the temple. He brought his
princess with him. They wanted to look at me. They climbed up
a tower in the temple, and looked down at me where I lay.

The next day the Emperor of Lilliput came to see me again. He looked magnificent in his robe
and was mounting a small horse. I tried to speak to him in English, but he did not understanc
me. I tried all the languages I knew, but he still did not understand me. He stayed about twc
hours, and then he went away. He left some soldiers in charge of me.
